utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve already started spreading the word, and I can pass your name along too if you’d like. Want the invite and details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please pass my name along — send me the invite and whatever details you’ve got, and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the invite and details, and I’ll pass your name along now too. Thanks, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are we heading over for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I’ve heard it’s getting a good turnout. If you want, I can check around and pass along the update.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell — please check and let me know the time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what’s already covered and get back to you. What items are still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s mostly the loose gate and some screws and basic tools, right? Just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that sounds right—mostly the loose gate, screws, and basic tools. I’ll check what’s already covered and let you know if anything else is still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’m a bit foggy today, so I may be missing details. I know Vik was passing the repair drive plans along, but I don’t have the date or organizer straight right now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — I’m keeping a note, but I only know we’ve got volunteers lined up and folks can bring small broken items. If you can confirm the date or organizer, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m sorry, Cleo — I still don’t have the date or organizer straight. If I hear it from Vik, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send me the exact details and invite, and I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the repair drive details and invite to the others right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks—once I have the details, I’ll share them out right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re collecting donations and volunteers this week—it sounds like it’s picking up nicely. I’ll keep an ear out if anything specific comes up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—could you let me know when the repair drive starts and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll keep an ear out for the start time and who’s organizing it, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. If you can drop them off this afternoon, that works for me—do you know if they also need nails or any other small supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. If you hear anything, could you let me know whether they need nails or other small supplies too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — please bring any small broken items you want fixed, and we’ll have volunteers on hand to help out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a few broken odds and ends. What time does the drive start?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll let people know it’s Sunday at the community center. What items or tools should I mention they’re collecting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the item list yet, but I can help track it if you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What do you need me to bring or fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — could you bring any basic tools you’re comfortable sharing, and if you know anyone who needs help, send them our way on Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can bring some basic tools and pass the word along. I’ll check with a few neighbors and let you know if anyone needs help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m still keeping it light, but I can help at the front porch on Saturday with something simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — simple is fine by me. I can help a little too if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I appreciate that — just a little help at the porch would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s going well so far—I'll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—thanks, Ira. I’ll go ahead and get those tools ready for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Gus. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over the hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measure this afternoon for the repair drive. Just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s perfect, Gus — I’ll let the others know you’re bringing those tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — happy to help out. Just send me a note if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard it’s just getting started, so I can help a little if you need me. What kind of repairs are you focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey. What date does the repair drive start, and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the exact date yet, and I don’t know who’s organizing it. I just heard it was getting started, so I thought I’d check in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Leo — could you bring whatever tools you have and help sort the jobs when you get here? I can point out what needs fixing and who needs which kind of help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my tools and help sort the jobs when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I’ll be there around 10 to help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Sam — that’ll help a lot. I’m running a little late as usual, but I’ll come by and help with the repair drive plans too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — just swing by when you can, and we’ll get it sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Kira — I’m happy to spread the word. What time should I tell people the repair drive starts, and what should they bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the start time and whether they should bring their own tools, or is it just the basics?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking the exact start time, but I’ll let everyone know it’s just the basics unless the organizers say otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — I’m still by my place for now, and I’ll let you know if that changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note you’re still at your place for now. The repair drive is Sunday at the community center, so let me know if you need the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll reach out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re collecting donations and volunteers this week—it sounds like it’s picking up nicely. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything specific comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m hearing the same, and I can help spread the word if anything specific comes up. Just let me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Nell — I will. If I hear what they still need, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what items they’re collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just a few small fixes now — we still need screws, basic tools, and help patching the loose gate. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — that helps. If you hear anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve already been spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to pass your name along too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — go ahead and pass my name along, and I’ll keep an ear out too if I hear any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll put your name on the list and keep you in the loop if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll keep your task simple. Just bring yourself, and I’ll point you to something easy when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll be there Sunday and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli — I appreciate it. I’ll save you an easy job for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me. Do you know what items they’re collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure on the full list, but I can help check—do you want me to find out before we head over?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that would be great—please check what’s still needed and let me know before we go.
